coordinates.space: Blender world metres at model bind pose

matching.method: Match per-triangle bind-pose world centroid and area, or corner position+UV; do not rely on Blender/Unity vertex indices.
matching.preserve: Original UVs, normals, tangents, bone weights, bind poses and original material. Duplicate seam vertices when splitting renderers.

fixed_parts: internal old boot/shin surface below .50m within radius .14m of (-.0178,-.04)
recommendations.skirt: Pin all vertices at z>=.90 and blend mobility over .72<z<.90. Keep fixed seam with torso. Outer/inner are colour regions on the same generated surface: simulate as a single Skirt renderer, preserving the original colour boundary.
recommendations.veil: Pin z>=1.46; blend to free below1.19. Central frontal head is excluded; side boundary additionally pinned.
recommendations.ribbon: Optional small secondary motion; only neutral-white frontal tails below1.335. Pin z>=1.31 and blend to full below1.23. Hair and central neckline are excluded.
recommendations.sleeves: Keep shoulder and forearm skeleton motion. Only distal cuff has maximum12% mobility; hands and wrists remain fully animation-driven. May omit for stability.
recommendations.hair: Leave fully fixed for this generated single surface. Colour-based blue hair extraction risks moving eyelash/face triangles.
recommendations.collision: Use only the listed body colliders per relevant cloth. Exclude hands/forearms from skirt if unnecessary. Do not use an oversized head collider that pushes the hood away.
recommendations.interior_repair: The 62/25-point skirt components are waist fabric and remain simulated. Boot/shin remnants belonged to the main 4307-point component. Only central low interior faces are assigned FixedBody (-1); their shared skirt boundary stays pinned.
recommendations.limitations: Colour separates visible cloth layers but does not prove independent physically separate panels. A welded-position seam audit and preview review are included before use.
